name: Fried rice with squid
notes: Rachel Cooks Thai: 3 cups (about 475 g) of cooked jasmine rice, 2 eggs, 2 garlic cloves, 3 tbsp shallot, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp soy sauce for 3 plates; the crab version 3 cups rice, 1/2 cup crab meat, 2 eggs for 4. A street plate holds 200 g of rice, one egg and 1.5 tablespoons of oil (18 g); the pages leave the oil out. Protein is the cooked weight, 55 g. Squid is raw weight.
